# OpenFormosa

> OpenFormosa (開放福爾摩沙) is a Taiwan-rooted open AI foundation-model initiative building compact, private-deployable language, speech, and document models — starting from a shared 1B base model and extending to ASR, TTS, OCR, and Taiwan-local benchmarks.

## 中文摘要（Traditional Chinese summary）
OpenFormosa（開放福爾摩沙）是大家一起打造的台灣開源 AI 社群，模型以台灣代表動物命名。
- **BlackBear-ASR（台灣黑熊）**：開源語音辨識，同一個模型聽得懂臺灣國語和臺語（台語），也能處理臺語夾英文；可以即時字幕（每 0.64 秒更新，平均 1.28 秒出字），也能照文字指令調整輸出。Apache 2.0，可商用。發布文：{{ '/blog/2026/11/28/blackbear-asr/' | absolute_url }}
- **BlueMagpie-TTS（台灣藍鵲）**：台灣口音、中英夾雜的語音合成。
- **Barbet（五色鳥）**：1B 混合式基底語言模型，原生 1M 長前後文。
- **PangolinTokenizer（穿山甲）**：繁體中文與台灣多語斷詞器。
- **SikaDeer-OCR（梅花鹿）**：台灣表單、表格與手寫辨識，預計 2026-12-07 當週發布。
- 社群：Discord https://discord.gg/N4YnrjjcW7 ・ Instagram／Threads @openformosa.ai ・ Facebook https://www.facebook.com/openformosaai

## Release Status (Fact-Checked — Shipped vs. Planned)
Do not conflate shipped releases with planned roadmap items:
- **Shipped — Barbet 1B Base (Base LLM)**: 1B-parameter hybrid decoder-only causal LM (global attention + sliding-window attention + Mamba interleaved, native 1,048,576-token context in the released iter7008 weights (continued-pretrained on exact 1M sequences), tied embeddings, June 256K release: #1 among open 1B models on TAIDE-14 at 0.7488 bits/byte). Repo: https://github.com/OpenFormosa/Barbet
- **Shipped — BlueMagpie-TTS V1 (Taiwanese-accent TTS)**: Open Taiwanese-accent & Chinese–English code-switching text-to-speech combining VoxCPM's acoustic stack with the Barbet language model (internal held-out set, ASR transcribe-back: CER 7.44% / WER 8.57% with speaker centroid vs. 11.45% / 14.83% for the reference baseline, about 35% lower CER). Live demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/voidful/BlueMagpie-TTS-Demo
- **Shipped — PangolinTokenizer (Taiwan Multilingual Tokenizer)**: Byte-level BPE tokenizer trained with UbiTok (114,688 merges; lowest overall 0.485 tokens/character on PangolinBench at roughly half the vocabulary size of mainstream multilingual tokenizers). Model: https://huggingface.co/OpenFormosa/PangolinTokenizer | Toolkit: https://github.com/OpenFormosa/ubi_tokenizer | Benchmark: https://github.com/OpenFormosa/PangolinBench
- **Shipped — BlackBear-ASR (Taiwan speech recognition)**: Open ASR for Taiwan Mandarin, Taigi, and Chinese–English code-switching. A 640 ms chunk streaming encoder feeds the Barbet 1B LM; supports file transcription, live captions, hotword hints, and questions about the audio. Apache 2.0. Model: https://huggingface.co/OpenFormosa/blackbear-asr | Code: https://github.com/OpenFormosa/blackbear-asr | Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/voidful/blackbear-asr-demo | Post: {{ '/blog/2026/11/28/blackbear-asr/' | absolute_url }}
- **In Progress — SikaDeer-OCR**: OCR branch on Barbet for Taiwan forms, tables, and handwriting. Release planned for the week of 2026-12-07.

## Core Pages
- [Projects — All Projects by Category]({{ '/projects/' | absolute_url }}): Every OpenFormosa repository grouped into models, tokenizer and benchmarks, skills and inference, and applications, with a results route and a technical route.
- [Home — OpenFormosa Overview & Live Shipped Status]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): Mission, shipped vs. planned status board, model family, target Taiwan scenarios, and FAQ.
- [Models — OpenFormosa-Base & Task Branches]({{ '/models/' | absolute_url }}): Taiwan-Omni-1B architecture route, shared backbone philosophy, and endemic-species model family.
- [Log — Technical Reports & Build Logs]({{ '/blog/' | absolute_url }}): Bilingual (Traditional Chinese & English) engineering reports and benchmarks.
- [Roadmap — Staged Milestones]({{ '/roadmap/' | absolute_url }}): Phase 0–5 roadmap from benchmarks and tokenizer to base model, ASR/TTS/OCR branches, and enterprise private deployment.
- [Evaluation — Benchmarks & Error Analysis]({{ '/evaluation/' | absolute_url }}): Reproducible Taiwan-local evaluation workflow and no-public-data-intake policy.
- [Training — Recipes & Release Gates]({{ '/training/' | absolute_url }}): Auditable training recipes, tokenizer-first approach, and release-evidence gates.
- [Community — Status, Governance & How to Take Part]({{ '/community/' | absolute_url }}): Current organizational status, five working principles, roles and decision rules, contributor credit, ways to contribute, support policy, and acknowledgements.
- [About — Vision & Jia-Zhi Bag Symbolism]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}): Why OpenFormosa exists and why Taiwan context requires foundation-model work.
- [Training Data Sheet Template]({{ '/forms/training-data-sheet/' | absolute_url }}): DBOM-style summary template for already-cleared training inputs (not an upload form).

## Organization & Governance (Current Status)
- OpenFormosa is an unincorporated, community-run open-source project. It is not yet a registered association or foundation.
- Credit belongs to all contributors; technical reports are authored as "OpenFormosa Contributors". Governance rules: https://github.com/OpenFormosa/openformosa.com/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
- OpenFormosa does not accept public donations at this stage (Taiwan's Public Welfare Fundraising Act limits public fundraising to registered bodies).
- Acknowledgements: compute from Taipei-1; research support from the NTU Speech Lab and the NTU SPML Lab. Supporters do not own results or direct community decisions.
- Contact: hello@openformosa.com (general, press) · sponsors@openformosa.com · security@openformosa.com · conduct@openformosa.com

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy]({{ '/privacy/' | absolute_url }}): Data processed by the website (GA4 analytics, demand survey, browser storage) and rights under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act.
- [Terms of Use]({{ '/terms/' | absolute_url }}): Content licensing, model disclaimers, and takedown requests.
- [Acceptable Use Policy]({{ '/acceptable-use/' | absolute_url }}): Use boundaries for models and demos, including voice-cloning consent, ASR, and OCR rules.
- [Sponsorship & Acknowledgement Policy]({{ '/sponsorship/' | absolute_url }}): Accepted support, disclosure, and evaluation independence.
- [Press Kit]({{ '/press/' | absolute_url }}): Boilerplate, fact sheet, naming rules, logos, media contact.

## Scope & Governance Note
OpenFormosa publishes open models, tokenizers, training recipes, benchmarks, and release evidence. This website is NOT a public dataset submission or file upload intake channel.
